title.subtitle: The 40 rarest identity/action pairs in range, by when each was first seen. Rare and high-severity together is where to look first.

url.query: FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-default | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | EVAL actor = COALESCE(attributes.user.email, attributes.api_key.name, attributes.user.name, "<anonymous>"), actor_kind = CASE(attributes.user.email IS NOT NULL, "human", "service") | EVAL risk = CASE(attributes.event.action == "invalidate_apikeys", 45, attributes.event.action == "anonymous_access_denied", 35, attributes.elasticsearch.audit.security_config_change IS NOT NULL, 50, attributes.event.outcome == "failure", 40, (resource.attributes.service.name == "serverless-kibana" AND ((attributes.event.type IN ("change","creation","deletion") AND (attributes.event.action IS NULL OR NOT (attributes.event.action IN ("saved_object_open_point_in_time","saved_object_close_point_in_time")))) OR attributes.event.action IN ("rule_run_soon","secret_create"))) AND attributes.event.action IN ("workflow_run","workflow_test","workflow_execution_cancel"), 10, (resource.attributes.service.name == "serverless-kibana" AND ((attributes.event.type IN ("change","creation","deletion") AND (attributes.event.action IS NULL OR NOT (attributes.event.action IN ("saved_object_open_point_in_time","saved_object_close_point_in_time")))) OR attributes.event.action IN ("rule_run_soon","secret_create"))) AND (attributes.event.type == "deletion" OR attributes.event.action == "rule_disable"), 30, (resource.attributes.service.name == "serverless-kibana" AND ((attributes.event.type IN ("change","creation","deletion") AND (attributes.event.action IS NULL OR NOT (attributes.event.action IN ("saved_object_open_point_in_time","saved_object_close_point_in_time")))) OR attributes.event.action IN ("rule_run_soon","secret_create"))), 25, 0) | STATS events = COUNT(*), risk = MAX(risk), ts = MIN(@timestamp) BY actor, action = attributes.event.action | SORT events ASC | LIMIT 40
